rows.grounds: compound: aṇimā-ādi (siddhis beginning with aṇimā) + ūrdhvatas (upward) + tisraḥ (three, fem. nom. pl.); L1/L2: enumerative cosmology of three upward lines
fem. nom. pl. of paṅkti (row, line); L1/L2: refers to lines/rows in the world-measure compendium
compound: guru-śiṣya (teacher and disciple) + gāḥ (going to, reaching); L1/L2: describes transmission/inhabitants associated with these rows
indeclinable compound: tatra (there) + api (also); L1/L2: continues the enumerative account in that context
compound abl.: tri-guṇa (three guṇas) + chāyā (shadow/reflection) + yogāt (from conjunction/union); L1/L2: explains the cause of triplicity in the cosmological scheme
compound: tritvam (threefoldness) + udāhṛtam (declared, stated); L1/L2: doctrinal statement of the resulting triplicity
